# Internal country-scope helper; only call through the guarded public effect.
# Native sale tokens are adapted in localization; the value is the actual payout.
tv_sell_goods_with_temporary_supply_apply_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_market_supply_country
	custom_description = {
		text = tv_sell_goods_with_temporary_supply_description
		subject = this
		object = scope:tv_market_supply_market
		value = tv_market_supply_payout_value
		add_gold = {
			value = tv_market_supply_payout_value
		}
		scope:tv_market_supply_market = {
			add_temporary_demand = {
				type = demand:$demand$
				scale = { value = scope:tv_market_supply_amount }
				months = scope:tv_market_supply_months
			}
		}
	}
}
